# Kozlow & Rowell - Holistic Dentist in Dallas TX

> > Comprehensive holistic and biological dentistry practice in North Dallas offering advanced restorative, cosmetic, and preventive dental care with biocompatible materials and cutting-edge technology.

Kozlow & Rowell is a premier dental practice in North Dallas founded by Dr. Philip Kozlow and Dr. Josh Rowell, specializing in holistic and biological dentistry. The practice emphasizes mercury-free restorations, biocompatible materials, and advanced technologies like CEREC same-day crowns and ozone therapy to deliver personalized, health-conscious dental care.
